featured_reviews.name: Harsh Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience here was okay-okay. The aesthetic of this place was good. The shop was empty at evening, hence I got quick service. The staff was friendly and communication was swift. I ordered a taco meal for Rs. 180 and received a very small taco. I don't think one small taco for a Rs. 180 meal was worth. The food taste was average. They accept cash, UPI, and online payment. No washroom or handwash was available however. The AC was not on, overall ambience was okay. The location of this mini restaurant is in a busy well known area. I would recommend this place to friends if a few things I mentioned above get worked on proportionately because at this time I didn't feel my money spent was worth.

featured_reviews.name: Ankeeta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited here in Mahavir Nagar, Kandivali, and unfortunately, it was a highly disappointing experience. Both the food and the service left much to be desired.

We started our meal with the loaded nachos, which were nothing short of terrible. The nachos were stale, and the toppings were sparse and lacked flavor. Next, we tried the tacos, which were equally disappointing. The shells were soggy, and the sauce and filling were subpar and tasted off. It didn't resemble anything close to authentic tacos and was a poor imitation at best.

The burrito bowl was another letdown. The rice had a burnt taste that was impossible to ignore, making the entire dish unacceptable. It's clear that care and quality control were severely lacking in the kitchen.

The only redeeming item was the crinkle peri peri fries, which were decently seasoned and crispy. However, one good item out of an entire meal is not enough to save the experience.

To add to the disappointment, the staff was inattentive and unresponsive. Despite the clear dissatisfaction of multiple customers, there was no effort made to address concerns or improve the service. Other diners were equally displeased, as evidenced by their complaints and poor reviews.

In conclusion, Mexibay in Mahavir Nagar, Kandivali, is not a place I would recommend. The food quality was abysmal, and the service was equally poor. Save your time and money and choose another dining option.

featured_reviews.name: Subha Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bhagwati Pav Bhaji is amongst the best and well known for a long time now. This is my second visit after 5 years and I secretly hoped (target I was scared) they had not messed with the taste and the simplicity of a classic pav bhaji!!! Luckily nothing had changed and I was glad to find my favourite pav bhaji in it's straightforward and simple form. So many places dunk their bhaji in tonnes of butter, which doesn't happen here. The right amount of spice, butter. I recommend the classic Pav Bhaji and if you have appetite for more, go for a plate of Kadak Pav, which is crunchy, yummy. I also tried Tawa Pulav, which is not really too spicy and quantity is quite generous.

To complete the meal, we went for a cold coffee, which is one of the best I've ever had, outside home! One doesn't go to Bhagwati for cold coffee, but i would highly recommend this here, for the following reasons : cold coffee definitely needs to taste like coffee, not like dessert, that's reason number 1, here you can actually taste coffee(not just a hint or mild flavour). The sugar levels are just right, not overpowering, it tastes coffee, not coffee shake!!! Third and last reason, there's nothing corrupting this experience in the form of chocolate syrup, chips or ice cubes, it's simply coffee that's mild and cold and right sweet!!! Wow! Didn't expect this surprise at Bhagwati.

If you are in the Western suburbs of Mumbai and are hungry, head here for a nice dinner

Service is quick and unobtrusive. They serve free water along with food, as in all Indian restaurants and eateries.

It's a simple eatery, no frills, with steel table tops and relatively relaxed if one arrives at around 8-830pm on a week day. One can find parking easily on the road after 8pm in that lane.

Their Pav bhaji is awesome, it comes with three paav, red chutney and some onion-tomato salad. Menu comprises of a variety of Dosa and other items.

This outlet is also known for its late night (beyond 3am) availability. They have a large seating at the back side of their restaurant.

Avoid passing by their kitchen area, it won't seem quite hygienic! Lesser you see, more you will enjoy their food. :)

Service speed depends on the crowd they have at that time. Usually very prompt, but keep reminding about your order. Avoid here if you want a quick bite.

Parking can be an issue on the roadside.

I visited Bhagwati Pav Bhaji at Iraniwadi and had an overall average to good experience. The food quality is good and the taste has remained consistent over time, which is something I appreciate. Their pav bhaji has the familiar signature flavor people come for, and the quality is generally reliable.

One of the good things about this place is that you know what to expect—the taste is steady and does not fluctuate much, which shows consistency in preparation. It is a nice place to visit when craving classic Mumbai-style pav bhaji and other fast-food items.

However, I do feel the pricing is on the higher side. While the food is good, the prices seem a bit expensive compared to similar places offering comparable taste and quantity. Because of that, it feels more like an occasional visit spot rather than a regular go-to place.

The ambiance and service are decent, and the place has its own popularity, especially among people who have been visiting for years. Overall, good and dependable taste with a satisfying food experience, but the higher pricing slightly affects the overall value for money. A good place to try, especially if you enjoy consistent flavors, though prices could be more reasonable.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rating: ★★★★★

Had an amazing experience at Bhagavati Pav Bhaji in Kandivali West! This place truly lives up to its reputation for serving some of the most flavorful and satisfying street-style food in the city.

Pav Bhaji – The star of the show! The bhaji was rich, buttery, and perfectly spiced with a hint of smokiness. The pav was soft, nicely toasted, and generously buttered. It was served piping hot with chopped onions and lemon on the side – just how it should be. Absolutely delicious and filling!

Pulav Khichadi – Surprisingly, this turned out to be a hidden gem on the menu! It had the comfort of khichadi with the flavors of pulav – mildly spiced, full of veggies, and topped with crunchy farsan and a dollop of ghee. It was both comforting and flavorful, perfect if you want something lighter yet tasty.

The place was clean, service was quick, and the staff was polite. It gets crowded in the evenings, but the wait is totally worth it.

If you’re in Kandivali West and craving good street-style food, Bhagavati Pav Bhaji should definitely be on your list!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Paandaa Momo in Kandivali West! From the moment I placed my order, I was impressed by their genuine care and commitment to customer satisfaction. I ordered a portion of Paneer Momos and Schezwan Momos, but unfortunately, they didn't have Schezwan momos available. What truly stood out was how they handled the situation.

Despite not being able to reach me over the phone, they promptly replaced the Schezwan Momos with Paneer Momos and, as a kind gesture, delivered a complimentary portion of Veg Momos along with a heartfelt handwritten note explaining the situation. To top it off, they included a small chocolate as a thoughtful touch.

In today's fast-paced world, especially in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities, genuine customer service like this is rare and precious. Paandaa Momo's warm, attentive approach truly made my day and restored my faith in great service. The taste of their momos is delicious—fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection.

I am 100% a returning customer and highly recommend Paandaa Momo to anyone craving authentic, tasty momos with a side of excellent service. Kudos to the team for their honesty, kindness, and dedication!
